change: VK_KHR_incremental_present damage-aware GPU copy with zero-damage present skip

patch.base: pinned wsi commit d5624d42 plus patches 0001-0004, verified with git apply --cached --check

probe_present_regions.note: first present per image is a full copy (accumulated damage starts unknown); 36 of 40 reused-image presents recorded partial rect copies with honest damage claims

probe_present_zero_damage.note: 36 of 40 unchanged-frame presents skipped both the GPU copy and the X11 present

activation.running_processes: unchanged; applications already running keep the r3.3 libraries until restarted

semantics.damage_source: VkPresentRegionsKHR (VK_KHR_incremental_present) forwarded by the WSI layer; extension advertised by the layer manifest
semantics.accumulation: rects union per presentation image since its last copy; missing or oversized hints degrade to a full copy
semantics.copy_selection: zero accumulated damage skips copy and X11 present; small updates copy only claimed rects; area >= 50 percent or unknown damage keeps the cached full copy
semantics.trust_model: claims are only a hint contract; an application that changes pixels outside its claimed rects would show stale pixels (probe tests send honest supersets)

boundaries: no Chromium/Electron runtime check of incremental-present damage forwarding yet (ANGLE support exists in binaries; applications not restarted)
pixel results verified by probe completion, mock rect validation and real-window runs; no user visual spot-check recorded
power, thermal and long-run effects of skipped/partial copies not measured
no zero-copy claim; a full copy remains the fallback and the AHB transport is unchanged
skipped presents rely on the application damage contract; misbehaving applications fall back only if hints are absent, not if they lie
